verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents a self-serve hosted fine-tuning path. Its official guides cover supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on your own examples and reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) of reasoning models with a feedback signal you define. The pricing docs publish fine-tuning prices without any sales contact, which supports the self-serve claim. Missing for 10: detail on supported base models and the job/data-format workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the fine-tuning API.
